stem: Which of the following best describes the principal molecular mechanism by which Arginine Vasopressin (AVP) exerts its antidiuretic effect in the principal cells of the collecting duct?

options.text: Activation of V1a receptors leading to IP3 accumulation
Activation of V2 receptors, Gs-protein coupled adenylyl cyclase stimulation, and PKA-mediated Aquaporin-2 apical exocytosis
Inhibition of V2 receptors to enhance sodium reabsorption
Direct translocation of Aquaporin-1 to the basolateral membrane via cGMP pathway

sourceExplanation: Arginine Vasopressin 主要作用於 collecting duct 的 principal cells 上之 V2 Receptor。V2 Receptor 透過 Gs-protein 啟動 adenylyl cyclase 產生 cAMP，進而活化 PKA。PKA 會促進含有 Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) 的 vesicles 穿梭至 apical membrane，增加 water reabsorption。

stem: A 32-year-old male with bipolar disorder presents with significant polyuria. His medication includes Lithium. What is the molecular basis of his Lithium-induced Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus?

options.text: Lithium directly inhibits Arginine Vasopressin release from the Posterior Pituitary
Lithium inhibits GSK-3beta and cAMP generation, impairing Aquaporin-2 expression and translocation
Lithium causes selective destruction of magnocellular neurons in the Supraoptic nucleus
Lithium downregulates V1a receptors in the collecting duct

sourceExplanation: Lithium-induced Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus 的機轉在於 Lithium 進入 principal cells 後，會抑制 GSK-3beta 以及 cAMP 產生，干擾 PKA pathway，從而減少 Aquaporin-2 的 synthesis 與 apical membrane translocation。
qcNotes: QC verified. Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: Which electrolyte abnormality is a well-recognized cause of acquired Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus?

options.text: Hypercalcemia downregulating Aquaporin-2 via calcium-sensing receptor activation

sourceExplanation: Hypercalcemia 是引發 acquired Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus 的常見原因。升高的 calcium 會活化 calcium-sensing receptor，進而抑制 adenylate cyclase，降低 cAMP，最終 downregulating Aquaporin-2 的 expression 與 apical transport。Hypokalemia 亦會引發 NDI。
qcNotes: QC verified. Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: Most inherited forms of Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus are caused by mutations in which of the following genes?
sourceExplanation: Congenital Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus 最常見 (佔 90%) 的原因是位於 X chromosome 的 V2 Receptor (AVPR2) 發生 gene mutation。其餘少數則為 autosomal recessive 或 autosomal dominant 的 Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) mutation。Neurophysin II mutation 則與 familial Central Diabetes Insipidus 有關。
qcNotes: QC verified. Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: Arginine Vasopressin is synthesized primarily in which nuclei of the hypothalamus?
sourceExplanation: Arginine Vasopressin 主要於 hypothalamus 的 Supraoptic nuclei (SON) 與 Paraventricular nuclei (PVN) 的 magnocellular neurons 中合成，隨後經由 Neurophysin II 運送至 Posterior Pituitary 進行 storage and release。

stem: During a Water Deprivation Test, a patient's plasma osmolality reaches 305 mOsm/kg H2O, while urine osmolality plateaus at 150 mOsm/kg H2O. Following administration of exogenous DDAVP, the urine osmolality increases to 600 mOsm/kg H2O. What is the most likely diagnosis?
sourceExplanation: 在 Water Deprivation Test 中，給予 Desmopressin (DDAVP) 後 urine osmolality 上升超過 50%，代表 kidney 對 AVP 有良好反應，但 endogenous AVP 分泌不足，此為典型的 Complete Central Diabetes Insipidus。若是 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus，則給予 DDAVP 後 urine osmolality 上升會小於 10%。
reconciliationNotes: Both NLM responses selected option A, matching source provided answer A.
qcNotes: QC verified. NLM #1 (A) and NLM #2 (A) agree with sourceProvidedAnswer (A). Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: A baseline unstimulated plasma Copeptin level of 35 pmol/L is highly indicative of which condition?

options.text: Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuretic Hormone Secretion (SIADH)

sourceExplanation: Copeptin 是 prepro-AVP 的穩定 cleavage product。Baseline unstimulated plasma Copeptin 大於 21.4 pmol/L 毫不含糊地指出這是一個 AVP 高度 compensatory secretion 但 kidney 不反應的狀態，即 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus。
reconciliationNotes: Both NLM responses selected option C, matching source provided answer C.
qcNotes: QC verified. NLM #1 (C) and NLM #2 (C) agree with sourceProvidedAnswer (C). Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: A patient presents with polyuria and polydipsia. A hypertonic saline infusion test is performed to stimulate AVP release. If the stimulated plasma Copeptin level is 2.1 pmol/L while serum sodium is 150 mEq/L, which diagnosis is most strongly supported?
sourceExplanation: 在 hypertonic saline 刺激下，當 plasma sodium 或 osmolality 達到 hypertonic state 時，若 stimulated Copeptin 仍然偏低 (小於 4.9 pmol/L)，這支持了 pituitary gland 無法適當分泌 AVP 的診斷，亦即 Central Diabetes Insipidus。若大於 4.9 pmol/L，則較偏向 Primary Polydipsia。
reconciliationNotes: Both NLM responses selected option B, matching source provided answer B.
qcNotes: QC verified. NLM #1 (B) and NLM #2 (B) agree with sourceProvidedAnswer (B). Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: Which of the following is an appropriate endpoint to terminate the fluid deprivation phase of a Water Deprivation Test?

options.text: Body weight loss of > 3% or plasma osmolality > 300 mOsm/kg H2O
Two consecutive hours of unchanged heart rate

sourceExplanation: Water Deprivation Test 中止 fluid deprivation 的 criteria 包含：body weight loss 超過 3%、Plasma Osmolality 大於 300 mOsm/kg H2O、Serum Na 大於 145 mEq/L，或連續多次收集 urine 其 Urine Osmolality 達到 plateau (變化 < 10%)。此時應抽血驗 AVP/Copeptin 並給予 DDAVP 進行測試。
reconciliationNotes: Both NLM responses selected option B, matching source provided answer B.
qcNotes: QC verified. NLM #1 (B) and NLM #2 (B) agree with sourceProvidedAnswer (B). Source explanation cleaned for pure English medical terms.

stem: In a patient with long-standing Primary Polydipsia, what is the expected maximal urine osmolality response after DDAVP administration at the end of a water deprivation test?

options.text: Urine osmolality typically exceeds 800 mOsm/kg H2O robustly
Urine osmolality blunted, often only increasing by 10-50% due to medullary washout
No change in urine osmolality, staying below 100 mOsm/kg H2O
Urine osmolality drops dramatically due to vasopressinase activity

sourceExplanation: 長期的 Primary Polydipsia 會造成 chronic excessive water intake，這會導致 renal medulla 的 medullary washout。因此，在 Water Deprivation Test 末期給予 DDAVP 時，即使有 exogenous hormone，kidney 的 urine concentrating capacity 仍然受損，導致 blunted post-DDAVP response (通常上升 10-50%)，無法達到極高的 urine osmolality。
reconciliationNotes: NLM Run 1 selected B; NLM Run 2 noted <10% vs 10-50% post-DDAVP nuance (NONE), but both confirmed medullary washout mechanism in Primary Polydipsia. Option B accepted.
qcNotes: QC verified. NLM #1 (B) selected B; NLM #2 noted strict cutoff nuance (NONE) but confirmed medullary washout mechanism. Option B matches sourceProvidedAnswer.
